description: This file defines a React functional component 'DeviceDetail' that displays detailed information about a device, including its status, allows refreshing status, editing, deleting, and pinging the device. It handles data fetching, user interactions, and conditional rendering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches device details from API and updates state.

methods.name: loadStatus
methods.description: Fetches device status from API and updates state.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Sends a ping request to the device and updates status and toast.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Opens confirmation dialog for device deletion.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms device deletion, calls API, and navigates away upon success.
